sampling_limitation: Visual review covers the listed sample frames and all generated QA images, not every original frame. Full mask coverage and hashes were checked automatically; fine boundary accuracy and later Body reconstruction quality remain unverified.
findings: Inspected overview review-001 and both targets sheets at all nine sample frames. The green-shirt foreground actor remains selected through bending, stepping through the hoop, torso flexion and turning away. Head, visible arms and legs remain localized; the seated background person and tripod are excluded. Thin hoop contact does not create a visible Body-localization blocker in these samples. No automatic mask flags or invalid frames were reported. Camera status is consistent across 13 sampled frames: focal median 836.202 px, relative p10-p90 spread 1.39%, maximum relative deviation 1.68%, no blockers. Temporal consistency does not establish absolute calibration, distortion or principal-point accuracy.
